messages:
marcus.s: Hey team — Prospect (ClinicaHealth) wants a one-week POC. They asked for a single dataroom upload with all SOC2/ISO artifacts + signed pen test attestation. Can we agree an ingest policy and who owns the scan window?
sofia.se: Quick q — do they need the raw scan reports or just the attestation letter + network diagram? Sometimes customers only need the letter + evidence index.
tim.security: They requested full reports in the ask, but we can offer a redacted bundle. Important: any raw scan exports with IPs need presigned upload and a 7-day ephemeral window. Ops prefers we avoid long-lived keys.
marcus.s: ClinicaHealth said legal will want full reports initially for the security team, legal will redact before wider sharing. Pricing note: POC uses reserved staging capacity — that may bump the quote.
olivia.legal: @marcus.s we need signature on our pen-test letter template from the external vendor. I'll attach the template here after sign-off. Also propose this clause in the ingest policy: "Redwood will accept reports via presigned S3 upload; customer is responsible for redaction requests post-ingest." Thoughts? :thinking_face:
hana.eng: Ops note — we can create a scoped presigned bucket with object key prefix `clinica-poc/` and lifecycle TTL 30 days. For the scan window (external vuln scan), we can schedule Tuesday 00:00–04:00 PT to avoid peak. That slot works for GPU staging too.
sofia.se: Can we split the SLA/billing? i.e., Redwood covers the dataroom storage ingestion (no extra charge first 30d), customer covers external scan cost and any dedicated reserved nodes to reproduce issues. That would make the POC line-item clearer.
tim.security: Agree on split. Also need the pen-test attestation to explicitly state scope (staging subnet IPs + container images) and the CVE redaction policy. I'll paste the short snippet we need to include:

```
Pen-test attestation snippet:
- Scope: staging env (eligibly listed CIDR / hostnames)
- Data handling: raw reports accepted, Redwood retains copy for 30 days, customer may request redaction within 14 days
- Distribution: attestation letter can be shared externally
```

marcus.s: Perfect — Olivia can you add the snippet and send to vendor? I'll pass the presigned upload flow to the buyer.
ops-bot: presign-link-ready: https://files.redwood.test/presign/clinica-poc?ttl=7d (example). Generated by ops-bot at 1747204460. :white_check_mark:
olivia.legal: Added the snippet and uploaded vendor-ready pen-test letter draft to the dataroom. Tagging @tim.security for sign-off.
tim.security: Reviewed, small edit on scope CIDR — changed `10.4.0.0/20` -> `10.4.16.0/20`. :thumbsup:
sofia.se: Sales ops item: I'll update the quote to include a "POC compliance handling" line: storage ingest (free 30d), presigned upload support, and optional vendor coordination fee if we act as signer liaison.
marcus.s: Good. Next steps: Olivia send vendor letter + sign-off, ops create presigned path and share exact S3 URL, Sofia update quote and send to buyer. If all agreed, I'll request a canary dedicated slot for the POC start next Monday.
hana.eng: Canary slot request noted — will confirm capacity by EOD.
marcus.s: Thanks all. Closing loop once vendor signs. :pray:
